question: 48 + (72 + 16) - 34 times 2 + 19 + 11 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply BODMAS: Solve bracket, then multiplication, then group addition.

48 + (88) − 68 + 19 + 11

48 + 20 + 30 = 98

**∴ The correct answer is 98.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 48 + (72 + 16) − 34 × 2 + 19 + 11

Method: BODMAS Rule (Bracket, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ 48 + 88 − 34 × 2 + 19 + 11

⇒ 48 + 88 − 68 + 19 + 11

⇒ 136 − 68 + 19 + 11

⇒ 68 + 19 + 11

⇒ 87 + 11 = 98

**∴ The correct answer is 98.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Standard order for solving mathematical expressions: Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

Grouping Terms

For faster calculation, group all positive terms together and all negative terms together before the final subtraction.
